name: Can I paint new trim immediately after installation?

mainEntity.name: Can I paint new trim immediately after installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: While it might seem efficient, it's generally best to wait before painting new trim immediately after installation, especially if it's unfinished wood or a material that requires conditioning. Wood trim needs time to acclimate to your home's humidity and temperature to prevent warping or cracking post-painting. For materials like MDF or composite, a primer is often recommended first to ensure proper paint adhesion and a smooth finish. Your contractor will advise on the specific drying and priming times based on the trim material used.
acceptedAnswer.description: It's best to wait before painting new trim. Allow wood to acclimate and other materials may need priming for proper adhesion and finish.
